event_name: Red Bull Toro Rosso Honda Document 9 Date 21 June 2019 Time 12:12 2019 FRENCH GRAND PRIX 20 - 23 June 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 8), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: A 4th Internal Combustion Unit (ICE), 3rd Motor Generator Unit-Kinetic (MGU-K), 3rd Energy Store (ES) and 3rd Control Electronics (CE) have been used.
offence: Breach of Article 23.3 (a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the back of the starting grid.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance with Articles 23.3 a) and 23.3 b).
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
